archetypes.name: dyn-hook-state
archetypes.rationale: Session-scoped hook state can regress cross-session counter isolation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the anti-read-poll hook's state-key change and harness coverage. Focus on whether generic Read counters now use the same session bucket fallback as task-output counters without changing thresholds, windows, or fail-open behavior. Check the tests prove both reset-suppression and inherited-count cases across same-cwd sessions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
